name: genomicschain_prov
description: GenomicsChain service (2.5) provenance anchoring, the customer/verifier half: reads a provenance bundle (BioCompute Object IEEE 2791-2020; Workflow Run RO-Crate in v0.2) into the seven recorded conditions, grades rebuild sufficiency with the Tier-2 six pin levels, and checks a bundle against its anchor proof. Reads only; the bundle stays with the customer.
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
